title: carex lachenalii var. glareosa

It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, due to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Carex lachenalii var. glareosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications in traditional medicine.
